note: kits/ancient-transit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md): the Ancients' transport infrastructure in ruin. Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py kits/ancient-transit after any change. Scales are world metres per tile; the builder writes UVs in metres.

asphalt.note: the deck surface, the ramps, the roads at grade

concrete.note: decks' sides, piers, guideways, stair towers, jersey barriers

steel.note: rails, crash barriers, masts, the furniture's metal

rust.note: every ruined metal: a bent lamp, a fallen gantry, a derailed wagon's frame

paint.note: the furniture bodies and the cars: the palette's colour, the set's chipping

white.note: the Ancients' seamed white panel: canopies, kiosks, the coaches

ballast.note: the cargo line's bed; a rail ballast set is owed (PROMPTS-NEEDED.md 37)

rubble.note: the chunks under a collapsed span, the pavement heaps

corrugated.note: box wagons' sides, the kiosk's shutter
